{{Vanilla|Rabbit Stew}}

|title=Rabbit Stew

'''Rabbit stew''' is the vanilla food, which [[Matcha Flavoured]] makes impossible to craft: the pack blocks both vanilla recipes, the ones that use a brown or a red [[mushroom]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> It is unrelated to [[Ramen]], although both use the rabbit stew item.

== Obtaining ==
No recipe, loot table or trade in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.4|1.12.4]] gives plain rabbit stew.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== 26.3 port ===
{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
''Minecraft'' 26.3 adds a third rabbit stew recipe, which uses a shelf mushroom, and the pack does not block it. In the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3 and on the repository's 26.3 branch, rabbit stew is crafted from a baked potato, [[Cooked Flesh|cooked flesh]] (the renamed cooked rabbit), a bowl, a carrot and a shelf mushroom, in any arrangement.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref> A shelf mushroom drops from a shelf mushroom block, which grows on trees in swamps and dappled forests in the 26.3 port.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/worldgen/feature/swamp_oak.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/worldgen/feature/red_poplar.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

== Usage ==
The pack gives plain rabbit stew no healing of its own, unlike the foods it makes, and it has no effect.
